changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names (Egoschema→EgoSchema) and model names (BLIP2→BLIP-2). Removed 'Image Captioning' task since the paper only mentions it in passing but doesn't evaluate it. Added Temporal Question Grounding as an evaluated NLG task. Removed generic 'LLMs' since specific models are listed.
Simplified IoU variants to base form as per guidelines. IoU@0.3 and IoU@0.5 are threshold variants of the same metric.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted in this paper. LLMs are used as generation models, not as judges.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper. All evaluations are conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on multimodal video understanding with NLG components rather than pure NLG evaluation. The NLG tasks are secondary to the main contribution of temporal grounding and multimodal reasoning. Automatic metrics are appropriately extracted, and no human or LLM-as-judge evaluations are conducted.
